Report: Trump's 'Board of Peace' plans Gaza humanitarian zone

A report indicates that Donald Trump's "Board of Peace" is planning to establish a pilot humanitarian zone in southern Gaza. The area, specifically Rafah, has reportedly been devastated by fighting and Israeli bombing during the ongoing conflict.
